_notes: Client-only text for the screens around a match (docs/design/ui-flow.md §2.3), read by packages/client/src/tips.ts. No rules here. versusTipsTh: one is shown on the versus screen before a match (picked by the match seed). lossTip: after a loss, the enemy card that dealt us the most damage is named with the first class in order it belongs to (battle.json counter classes; classTh = how the tip names that class), then a card of ours that counters that class (its counters list names it) is suggested with battle.json counterTags. lineTh fills {card} {class} {counter} {example}.
